content.query:
WITH CustomerRiskRatingSK AS (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerRiskRatingSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating)

,DimCustomer_CRM AS 
(SELECT CustomerId ,CustomerSK ,BankSK,SourceSystemCode,ValidEndDate ,ValidStartDate 
    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ,CustomerSK ORDER BY ValidEndDate ,ValidStartDate) RN_RANK
FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND CurrentIndicator = 1)

,DimCustCRM AS (SELECT * FROM DimCustomer_CRM WHERE RN_RANK = 1)

,BCOCR AS 
(SELECT CustomerId ,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode,RiskRatingTypeId,PeriodStartDate ,CreditRiskId
FROM BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM'
GROUP BY CustomerId  ,FinancialInstitutionId ,SourceCode ,RiskRatingTypeId ,PeriodStartDate ,CreditRiskId)

,CRM AS (
SELECT DISTINCT
	DC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
	,DC.CustomerID AS CustomerID
	,DRRT.RiskRatingTypeSK AS RiskRatingTypeSK
	,DRR.RiskRatingSK AS RiskRatingSK
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
	,DC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm                     
FROM DimCustCRM DC
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DC.BankSK = DB.BankSK
LEFT JOIN BCOCR ON DC.CustomerID = BCOCR.CustomerId AND DB.BankID = BCOCR.FinancialInstitutionId
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRatingType DRRT ON BCOCR.RiskRatingTypeId = DRRT.RiskRatingTypeID AND DC.BankSK = DRRT.BankSK
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimRiskRating DRR ON BCOCR.CreditRiskId = DRR.RiskRatingID AND DC.BankSK = DRR.BankSK)
)
SELECT count(1) FROM DimCustCRM
UNION ALL
SELECT count(1) FROM CRM
